personality_one_liner: A highly readable, structured, and trustworthy operational dashboard where data clarity and status visibility are the absolute priorities.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for forms and lists. Touch targets must be 44pt+. Strict alignment for data tables.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar, floating action buttons, and sticky sticky headers over scrolling content
dont's: Do not use glass on data table rows, form inputs, or standard list cards

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level view showing critical KPIs, unit progress charts, and urgent alerts (pemutihan deadlines) to keep admins informed.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for KPI grid and charts.
states.empty: No data available for selected filter month/marketing. Clear filter CTA.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top section: Hero background image with a gradient overlay (scrim), displaying the Project Name and user role. Below hero: A 2x2 grid of KPI cards (Total, In Progress, SP3K, Done) using solid colors or distinct borders. Below KPIs: Horizontal scrollable filter pills (Month, Marketing). Main content: Stacked list or charts for Marketing/Unit stats and an 'Attention Required' section for nearing deadlines.

screens.name: Berkas KPR
screens.purpose: List and manage consumer mortgage files with clear status indicators.

states.loading: List skeleton with rounded card placeholders.
states.empty: Minimal illustration of empty desk with 'No KPR files found' text and 'Add New File' CTA.
states.error: Failed to fetch files. Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with search bar and filter button. Main content: Stacked cards. Each card displays Consumer Name (large), Bank & Marketing (muted), and a prominent colored status badge (Red/Amber/Green) anchored to the top right. FAB (Floating Action Button) anchored to bottom right for 'Add File'.

screens.name: Progres Bangunan
screens.purpose: Track unit construction progress and upload site photos.
screens.layout: List of units with progress bars (0-100%). Tapping a unit opens a Bottom Sheet (or detail screen) featuring a large camera/upload placeholder taking up 40% of the screen, followed by a form to update the construction milestone. A sticky primary 'Save Progress' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Legalitas
screens.purpose: Manage legality status of documents per unit and for the project.
screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Unit Legality vs. Project Legality). Below: A clean, dense list of documents. Each row has the document name and a trailing toggle or status dropdown.

screens.name: Pengaturan
screens.purpose: Admin settings for managing dropdown values and project info.
screens.layout: iOS-native grouped list style. Sections with light gray background, rows with white background and bottom divider. Chevron on the right to indicate drill-down.

empty_state_desk.alt: office paperwork files minimal on desk

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No blues anywhere (not even for accents or default links). The brand is a deep Pine Green to reflect housing/growth.
Implement clear status badging on lists using the success/warning/error colors. Make sure contrast ratios are AA compliant.
Ensure the layout supports large tables/lists without feeling cluttered. Use generous iOS native spacing and clean dividers.
For the dashboard, use the `dashboard_hero` image at the top with a strong gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, ending in dark gray) so the project title overlay is readable.
For 'Progres Bangunan' details, prioritize a large, easily tappable photo upload area since field admins will use this frequently on site.
The App requires role-based rendering (Admin Utama vs KPR/Legal/Bangunan). Mock the auth state robustly and ensure 'Pengaturan' is only visible if the role is Admin Utama.
Ensure sticky CTAs for form submissions (like 'Save Progress') are placed above the keyboard and safe area on mobile.
